title: Collinearity analysis of multi-replicon bacterial genomes (Vibrio spp.)
summary: Two Vibrio genomes, each with two chromosomes. Each chromosome is rotated in gbdraw to start at its replication initiator gene — dnaA on chromosome I and rctB on chromosome II — so records that NCBI starts at unrelated positions line up. Inversions occur within each chromosome, but collinear blocks rarely connect chromosome I to chromosome II. This tutorial finds each initiator with a qualifier search, starts its record there, and then runs LOSATP Collinear blocks once.
primaryWorkflow: Align replicons at their replication origin

manualSteps.title: Switch to Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Linear before adding the assemblies.

media.caption: Select Linear before adding the multi-record inputs.

manualSteps.title: Add the two assembly files
manualSteps.body: Add each assembly GBFF as its own File: GCF_000196095.1 as File 1 and GCF_000354175.2 as File 2. Each File lists its two chromosomes as records. In the first record of each File, enter the species in Organism / strain and the strain in Subtitle / title; leave both empty for the second chromosome.

media.caption: Upload the RIMD 2210633 GBFF as File 1, open its first record, NC_004603.1, and enter the species and strain text.

const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (!app || app.linearSeqs?.length !== 4) throw new Error('Expected four restored Linear records.'); app.sidebarWidth = 480; const seq = app.linearSeqs[0]; if (!seq?.gb?.name?.includes('GCF_000196095.1_ASM19609v1_genomic.gbff')) throw new Error('First restored GenBank file does not match the tutorial.'); if (app.linearSeqs[1]?.gb?.name !== seq.gb.name) throw new Error('First restored File does not hold both chromosomes.'); seq.definition = 'Vibrio parahaemolyticus'; seq.record_subtitle = 'RIMD 2210633'; const file = document.querySelector(`[data-linear-source-card="${seq.uid}"]`); const records = file?.querySelector(`[data-linear-source-records="${seq.uid}"]`); const options = file?.querySelector(`[data-linear-record-options="${seq.uid}"]`); if (!file || !records || !options) throw new Error('First Linear File card is unavailable.'); records.open = true; options.open = true; file.setAttribute('data-capture-tutorial-record-row', 'true'); file.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.body: Open Advanced comparison and layout, turn on Arrange in rows, assign the rows from the table above, and set Record gap to 48 px.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const inputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-label^="Linear record row for sequence"]')]; const expected = '1,1,2,2'; if (inputs.map((node) => node.value).join(',') !== expected) throw new Error('Restored row assignments do not match the tutorial.'); const heading = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-linear-advanced-comparison] .linear-primary-label')].find((node) => node.textContent?.trim() === 'Record Layout'); const panel = heading?.parentElement; const rows = inputs.map((node) => node.parentElement); if (!heading || !panel || rows.some((row) => !row)) throw new Error('Record Layout controls are unavailable.'); heading.setAttribute('data-capture-record-layout-heading', 'true'); rows.forEach((row, index) => row.setAttribute('data-capture-record-layout-row', String(index + 1))); const gap = [...panel.querySelectorAll('label')].find((node) => node.textContent?.includes('Record gap')); gap?.setAttribute('data-capture-record-layout-gap', 'true'); heading.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram before you set up a comparison; without one the preview is ready in seconds. In the search bar above the preview, set the search field to Qualifier value, type gene as the Qualifier key and dnaA as the query, and click Search. It finds the dnaA CDS of both species.

manualSteps.title: Start chromosome I at dnaA
manualSteps.body: Click Open for the first match. In its popup, open Rotate record using this feature, choose Start of the record, and click Apply on Generate. Click > for the second match and do the same.
manualSteps.note: All four initiators are on the + strand, so each record keeps its orientation. The new starts apply at the next Generate.

manualSteps.title: Run LOSATP in Collinear blocks mode
manualSteps.body: In Comparison, choose Run LOSAT. In Settings, set LOSAT Mode to LOSATP, LOSATP mode to Collinear blocks, Color mode to Orientation + identity, and Evidence scope to Adjacent pairs. Diagonal drift is under Advanced comparison and layout.
manualSteps.note: Adjacent pairs compares every chromosome in one row with every chromosome in the next row: four pairs here. Chromosomes in the same row are not compared.

media.alt: Comparison card with Run LOSAT pressed, closed Settings, and the Selected pairs disclosure.
media.caption: Choose Run LOSAT to activate comparisons across adjacent display rows.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('collinear'); }

manualSteps.title: Render every feature as a rectangle
manualSteps.body: In Features, set the shape of all seven Linear feature types to Rectangle.

media.alt: Features card with CDS, rRNA, tRNA, tmRNA, ncRNA, misc_RNA, and repeat_region all set to Rectangle.
media.caption: Set every selected feature type to Rectangle.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const features = ['CDS','rRNA','tRNA','tmRNA','ncRNA','misc_RNA','repeat_region']; if (!features.every((name) => app?.getFeatureShape?.(name) === 'rectangle')) throw new Error('Restored feature shapes are not all rectangles.'); const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card')].find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().startsWith('Features')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const section = card?.querySelector('details > div > div'); if (!summary || !section) throw new Error('Feature shape controls are unavailable.'); summary.setAttribute('data-capture-feature-summary', 'true'); section.setAttribute('data-capture-feature-shapes', 'true'); section.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Set the layout and definitions
manualSteps.body: Use the Above track layout, separate the strands, lock the definition column, and draw a 750,000 bp ruler on each axis. In Titles & Record Labels, turn off Replicon and hide Accession and Length / Coordinates so each definition shows only the species and strain.

media.alt: Layout card with Above track layout, Separate Strands, and Lock Definition Column selected.
media.caption: Use Above tracks, separate the strands, and lock the definition column.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (app?.form?.linear_track_layout !== 'above' || app?.form?.separate_strands !== true || app?.form?.keep_definition_left_aligned !== true) throw new Error('Restored Linear layout does not match the tutorial.'); const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card')].find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().startsWith('Layout')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const content = card?.querySelector('details > div'); const track = content?.children?.[0]; const options = content?.children?.[1]; if (!summary || !track || !options) throw new Error('Layout controls are unavailable.'); summary.setAttribute('data-capture-linear-layout-summary', 'true'); track.setAttribute('data-capture-linear-layout-track', 'true'); options.setAttribute('data-capture-linear-layout-options', 'true'); track.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Generate once and inspect
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The rotations and the comparison apply in this one run. Check the result:

media.alt: Two-row Vibrio diagram: each chromosome is rotated to start at its replication initiator, gray collinear and red inverted blocks join the rows, and the legend at the bottom lists the collinear and inverted block colors.
media.caption: Every row starts at its initiator; inversions stay within chromosome I or chromosome II.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.drawer-toggle')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('footer')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const rows = Array.isArray(app?.linearRecordRows) ? app.linearRecordRows.map((entry) => Number(entry?.row)) : []; if (JSON.stringify(rows) !== JSON.stringify([1, 1, 2, 2])) throw new Error('Restored Vibrio row placement does not match the tutorial.'); const content = String(app?.results?.[0]?.content || ''); const svg = app?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); if (!svg || !content.includes('Vibrio parahaemolyticus') || !content.includes('Vibrio alginolyticus') || !content.includes('Collinear') || !content.includes('Inverted') || svg.getElementById('plot_title')) throw new Error('Restored title-free Vibrio collinear SVG does not match the tutorial.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 0.55; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = 0; app.canvasPan.y = 0; } svg.setAttribute('data-capture-vibrio-overview', 'true');

() => { const svg = window.__GBDRAW_APP__?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); const featureLegend = svg?.getElementById('feature_legend_h'); const pairwiseLegend = svg?.getElementById('legend_horizontal')?.querySelector('[data-gbdraw-role="comparison-legend"][data-gbdraw-orientation="h"], #pairwise_legend_h, #pairwise_legend'); if (!featureLegend || !pairwiseLegend || svg.getElementById('plot_title')) return false; const matrix = (node) => node.transform?.baseVal?.consolidate()?.matrix || { e: 0, f: 0 }; const featureMatrix = matrix(featureLegend); const pairwiseMatrix = matrix(pairwiseLegend); const featureBox = featureLegend.getBBox(); const pairwiseBox = pairwiseLegend.getBBox(); const horizontalGap = pairwiseMatrix.e + pairwiseBox.x - (featureMatrix.e + featureBox.x + featureBox.width); return horizontalGap >= 20; }

items: Each row starts at its replication initiator, so the ruler counts from dnaA at the left end of chromosome I and from rctB at the left end of chromosome II.
Red (inverted) blocks join regions within chromosome I or within chromosome II.
Few blocks cross from chromosome I of one species to chromosome II of the other.

losatTips.title: Load the session to skip the LOSATP search
losatTips.body: The Gallery session holds the finished figure and every setting. Load it to inspect the result at once; changing a setting and generating again starts a new LOSATP search.

losatTips.title: Expect a long first run
losatTips.body: LOSATP compares four chromosome pairs of about 1.7 to 3.3 Mbp. The Gallery figure was made on the command line with 16 threads. In the browser, Safe leaves CPU cores free for the rest of the page.

losatTips.title: Style changes reuse the LOSATP search
losatTips.body: After the first run, color and layout changes regenerate quickly from the browser cache. Changing a chromosome, file, input order, or LOSAT threshold runs that pair's LOSATP search again.

troubleshooting.title: The search finds no feature
troubleshooting.body: Set the search field to Qualifier value and type the qualifier key: gene for dnaA, product for RctB.

troubleshooting.title: A record does not start at its initiator
troubleshooting.body: Apply on Generate waits for the next Generate Diagram. Check Display start in each record's Record options in its File card.

troubleshooting.title: Species names repeat above every chromosome
troubleshooting.body: Enter the species and strain only on the first chromosome of each row; leave both fields empty for the second.

troubleshooting.title: The browser becomes unresponsive
troubleshooting.body: Load the bundled session, switch LOSAT execution to Serial, or lower the thread budget before the full LOSATP search.
